page.guarTitle: Why Do You Need a Gas Detector?
page.guarText: Natural gas and CO (carbon monoxide) are invisible dangers. Even a small leak can have serious consequences. An automatic detector paired with a solenoid shut-off valve provides complete protection.
page.g1Text: At the slightest gas leak, the electric valve instantly cuts off the gas supply, even when nobody is home.
page.g2Text: The detector emits a loud high-frequency signal that wakes your family even at night.
page.g3Text: Our installation fully meets the requirements of gas companies and safety regulations.
page.guarCardText: After every installation our team performs a pressure tightness test.
